children: CGI has entered into a partnership with D-Wave Quantum to market and deploy quantum-computing systems to enterprise clients across transportation, logistics, and retail.
Through the go-to-market partnership, CGI will integrate quantum-computing company D-Wave's platforms into its advanced technology services portfolio.
The integration will allow clients to deploy quantum-based solutions to applications ranging from industrial production planning to energy grid optimization and asset maintenance scheduling.

The Canadian IT consulting company on Wednesday said that it is already exploring applications of the technology in the fields of transportation and rail, as well as retail applications such as improving supply chain planning, delivery routing and workforce scheduling.
